mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key, aggregate_id, event_type, event_version, payload_json, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, published_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM analysis_outbox WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE analysis_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = #{nextAttemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{safeError}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
